g.text: The seed-to-seed spread in (a) comes from each price path's impermanent loss. Compared within the same seed (c), StoikovHook beats its fee-matched control consistently, by a small amount.

g.text: Static 0.30% beats both in (a) only because simulated uninformed traders do not react to fees.
